title: Does not work
text: Does not work. The possums I wanted to deter walked right through this stuff. The sniffed it and kept on scavenging. They did not leave the area even when I went outside and tried to scare them away. They scared me away. This product did not work at all, even the racoons were not deterred. I'm overrun with racoons and possums and I live in the city! Don't know what to do.
